listing.name: Avali Explorer [English Translation]
listing.summary: Yo this is a full translation of the AvaliExplorer by the CN author MAJORKai with a bit amount of AI assistant.
listing.aiSummary: Provides an English translation of the Avali Explorer mod, including a full Avali faction, heat weapons, and a questline.

description: Translates the Avali Explorer mod into English, featuring the Avalon Exploration Fleet faction and a list of heat weapons. Includes modular Sparrow shuttles and Falcon destroyers with swappable modules, as well as a questline involving the scientist Krss'Brk.
